description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the data synchronization instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：
- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> 默认取值为**Forward**。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，本参数传入**Reverse**才会生效。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> Default value: **Forward**. The value **Reverse** takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用[DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID.

title.zh: 查询同步作业的运行状态
title.en: Query the running status of a synchronization task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-synchronization-job-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsexjk1alb1160000 --synchronization-direction Forward --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeSynchronizationJobStatus --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtsexjk1alb1160000 --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000' --SynchronizationDirection Forward
